skills.skill_desc:
Phoveus's next Basic Attack charges at the enemy, knocking them back, dealing extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 4% - 6% of the enemy's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (scales with level), and gaining a 8% - 12% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> shield. Cooldown: 26s-14s (based on <font color="a6aafb">Infernal Pursuit</font>'s level).

<font color="a6aafb">Astaros' Gaze</font>: Whenever an enemy hero blinks, dashes, or is displaced within 8 units, reduces the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Force</font> by 20% and other skills by 0.5s.

Phoveus slams his monolith into the ground, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and slowing them by 70% for 0.5s. If this skill hits an enemy, Phoveus's next <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Impact</font> will leave behind an <font color="a6aafb">Astaros Eye</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Astaros Eye</font>: Implodes after a short delay, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the enemies.

Phoveus lowers his monolith and releases his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies airborne, dragging them along, and dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Force</font>, <font color="a6aafb">Astaros Eye</font>, and <font color="a6aafb">Dark Wave</font> apply <font color="a6aafb">Sinner's Mark</font> to enemy heroes hit.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Phoveus leaps into the air and smashes down with his monolith at the enemy hero with <font color="a6aafb">Sinner's Mark</font>, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and recovering <font color="26e407">50 (+ 6% of his <1998>)</font>.

<font color="A4AAC7">Infernal Pursuit can only be used when there are enemies with Sinner's Mark nearby. HP recovered is reduced by 80% when multiple enemies are hit.</font>
